d:
Todd Hoffman makes a bold move, shifting his entire operation to a new mine and finally getting paydirt running. But while Todd looks for a fresh start, Parker Schnabel faces a major setback as flooding puts his mining operation in trouble. Meanwhile, Tony Beets gets a massive result from his old dredge, which hits a record gold haul! With fortunes changing across the claims, whose gamble will pay off?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 7, Episode 6, on Discovery Channel India.
